findings: All eight admitted source bodies are captured before receipt/namespace creation and reused verbatim.
Exclusive namespace reservation precedes every version write. mkdir_new synchronizes each newly created entry in its parent; file writes synchronize file and parent before final selector.
The selector is created exclusively only after complete installed-byte/mode validation; bin directory is synchronized and source/installed identities are checked again.

Errors retain receipt, partial namespace/version and any published selector; created list records each successful creation immediately. Receipt rewrite is best effort and records its own failure when available.
Late stdout failure reports console phase with selector_may_exist and does not mislabel retained successful receipt as rollback.
Guide correctly distinguishes stable-owned-directory assumptions and improved durability from untested power-loss atomicity; no new locking/hostile-writer claim.
limitations: Root owns full source acceptance and Loom owns actual PATH/HTTP receiving.
No independent runtime, failure injection, power-loss or malicious concurrent directory mutation test performed.
Source/guide only; author test counts are attributed to Anvil, not independently replayed.
scope: Independent full installer/guide read, limited verdict on namespace and selector ordering, durability and retained failure state; read-only identity audit, no installer/test/server execution.
